name: architecture-bus-caption
text: Sensor buses: I²C / UART. FPGA link: 8-bit mode-0 SPI.

Source: docs/SHRIKEFI_LINK_PROTOCOL.md, docs/SHRIKEFI_HARDWARE_CONNECTIONS.md, and firmware/shrikefi/main_shrikefi.c. The MCU samples MAX30102 data, sends the IR path to ForgeFPGA over mode-0 SPI, and receives beat/IBI data. Red/IR ratio processing for SpO₂ stays on the MCU. The dashboard interfaces are distinct: a compact local SoftAP page and a richer USB serial desktop page.

The waveform is an RTL simulation image (docs/images/forgefpga_waveform.png), not a human measurement. The 50 MHz counter has a 20 ns tick; firmware validates intervals and signal quality before publication.

name: risk-caveat
text: BME280 temperature is ambient, not body temperature. Teacher agreement on synthetic data is not clinical accuracy.

Source: firmware/core/clinical_vitals_engine.c, firmware/core/disaster_risk_engine.c, firmware/core/nn_risk_model_int8.h, and docs/reports/AI_MODEL_AUDIT_2026-10-20.md. The deployed INT8 model has 619 bytes of parameter storage and 88.39% agreement with its synthetic rule teacher on a held-out synthetic validation set. This is not clinical performance. The device does not have a fitted body-temperature sensor; BME280 measures ambient air.
